採用・広告の製品.quote: Capture data with your team, ours, or a combination of both. Zeitview transforms it into prioritized asset intelligence, giving your team a clear view of where to focus and what action to take next.
Detailed inspections & actionable insights on Roof, Pavement, Facade, and Landscaping for property inspection and facility management. On-demand drone imagery and video to enhance CRE marketing.
Learn how roof inspection data, condition scoring, and repair cost estimates help facility managers prioritize maintenance, optimize budgets, and extend asset life.
A look at how Bureau Veritas modernized property assessments with drone-based inspections.
Award-winning Zeitview AI improves wind turbine inspections by detecting barely visible blade cracks earlier, reducing failure risk, and enabling more reliable, scalable wind operations.

Zeitview is an asset intelligence company for energy and critical infrastructure. It combines aerial and robotic data collection, AI-powered analysis, expert review, standardized reporting, and portfolio monitoring to help teams understand asset condition, prioritize issues, and decide what needs attention first.

Asset intelligence is structured information about an asset’s location, condition, severity, and inspection history that teams can use to make maintenance and operational decisions. Zeitview turns raw inspection data into prioritized findings, mapped evidence, and portfolio-level visibility so teams can focus on the assets and issues that matter most.

Zeitview supports asset inspection and monitoring across oil and gas, electric utilities, wind energy, solar energy, and commercial properties. The inspection method and analysis vary by asset type, but the goal is consistent: create a clearer view of asset condition and help teams prioritize maintenance, risk, and capital decisions.

Yes. Zeitview supports both managed data collection and bring-your-own-data workflows. Organizations can use Zeitview pilots and technicians, capture data with their own teams, or combine both approaches while centralizing inspection results and analysis in a consistent workflow.

Yes. Zeitview can deliver findings in standardized reports and support workflows that connect inspection results with systems such as GIS, enterprise asset management (EAM), and ERP platforms. This helps move inspection data into the systems teams already use for maintenance planning, asset management, and operational follow-through.
How can asset intelligence support preventive or predictive maintenance?

Asset intelligence gives teams a more consistent view of asset condition, issue severity, location, and change over time. That information supports preventive and risk-based maintenance by helping teams address higher-priority conditions earlier, while providing condition data that can contribute to broader predictive maintenance and asset lifecycle programs.
Our advanced inspections are proven to be more cost-efficient than traditional inspection methods, while enabling companies to make better capital allocation decisions.
Zeitview makes it easy to scale infrastructure intelligence, as a single partner for advanced inspections across solar, wind, utilities, oil and gas, and commercial properties.

Zeitview enables advanced data collection, AI-powered asset health monitoring, unified portfolio visibility, and turnkey operational insights to reduce risk, streamline O&M processes, and make more intelligent capital allocation decisions across your portfolio.

Prior to founding DroneBase (now Zeitview), Dan worked as a Special Assistant in the U.S. Senate and worked at Goldman Sachs, analyzing global corporations. Under Burton’s leadership, Zeitview has become the leading global provider of advanced inspections for infrastructure.

Headquartered in Santa Monica, CA, Zeitview is home to team members from across the globe who are passionate problem solvers and technical innovators who fuel Zeitview’s commitment to customers with their integrity and focus.
